extraction.title: Schumpeter
extraction.subtitle: SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic are already public companies Investors have countless ways to bet on their success
extraction.summary: SpaceX's impending IPO is set to reshape public markets, with significant implications for companies like Tesla and Alphabet. The rise of speculative investments linked to SpaceX and other AI firms like OpenAI and Anthropic highlights a trend of concentrated value in a few major firms amidst a decline in the number of listed companies.

events.event_summary: SpaceX plans to go public with a valuation of $2 trillion.
OpenAI and Anthropic also plan to list their shares this year.
